newsitem.title: DENMARK: Sonofon wins Danish DCS-1800 licence.
newsitem.headline: Sonofon wins Danish DCS-1800 licence.

text.p: Denmark's Sonofon was one of five bidders awarded Danish DCS-1800 mobile telephone licences on Wednesday, the Danish National Telecoms agency said.
Licences were awarded to four of the five original bidders; Sonofon, Tele Danmark, France Telecom Mobile and Sweden's Telia.
The fifth candidate was Sweden's Netcom Systems.

Sonofon, hitherto former monopoly Tele Danmark's only competitor, said that it would offer with the new system the option for customers to use their mobile telephones in the home at the same tariffs as fixed-line calls.
